meta.summary: Hides floating log-in button, Follow buttons, trending searches, feed category tabs, repost, comment and like counts, comments
meta.notes: LIVE (logged out, iPhone UA 390x844, headless Chromium, 2026-11-08, from a non-China IP): https://m.weibo.cn/ redirects through visitor.passport.weibo.cn and lands on the Vue mobile feed (#app). Seen: a fixed 'login-box' button (1 match, a.login-btn, floats at the bottom of every feed view), 'm-followBtn' Follow buttons in header.weibo-top (20 on the Charts tab, 0 on the Hot tab), nav-main category tab row (Hot/Charts/Local/Society/Tech/...: 1 match), footer.f-footer-ctrl with 3 .m-diy-btn counters per post (15 posts = 45 matches). Search page /search?containerid=231583: 2 div.card16.m-col-2 hot-search cards + 1 div.card11.ctype-3 (Hot people / Hot live tiles). Post page /status/<id>: div.lite-page-tab (3 .tab-item, counts are the second <i>), div.comment-content (1 list), fixed div.lite-page-editor ('Write a comment'), div.weibo-media on posts with pictures or video. A div.ad-wrap exists on post pages but is display:none and empty, so no ad rule ships. No cookie banner, app-install sheet, notification prompt or timed pop-up appeared in about 30 s of waiting on the feed. NOT hideable with CSS: after several scrolls or a reload loop Weibo redirects the whole tab to passport.weibo.com/sso/signin, and /profile/<uid> redirected to the same sign-in page straight away (no public profile is viewable logged out). Counter selectors rely on stable layout classes (no hashed names); the Vue data-v-* attributes are never used. NOT verified: logged-in views, the desktop weibo.com site, video.weibo.com, super-topic (/p/index) pages, the in-app (WebView) variant, mainland-China-only prompts. Fixtures are distilled by hand with English placeholder text.
